title: FoodRecipeApp
description: Recipe search page using the Edamam API, with results shown as cards.
highlights: Searches the Edamam Recipe Search API by keyword with a fetch call made straight from the browser.
Shows up to 30 results as cards with each recipe's image, meal type, name and rounded calories.
Responsive card grid (1, 2 or 4 columns) built with Tailwind utility classes.
note: A small single-screen app built in 2023 while learning React and Tailwind CSS.

title: bankLoan
description: Spring Boot REST API training exercise for sanctioning loans and loan reports.
highlights: Two REST endpoints: sanction a home or car loan for an existing customer, and list customers by loan type.
Rules live in a service layer: a fixed term and rate per loan type, one loan per customer, and an EMI computed for the report.
Persists customers and loans with Spring Data JPA and Hibernate on MySQL, with loan IDs from a database sequence.
note: A 2023 Java and Spring Boot training exercise, not a complete banking system.

title: formvalidation
description: Small form validated with React Hook Form and Yup.
highlights: A form field registered with React Hook Form and checked by a Yup schema: required, 3 to 6 characters.
Shows the validation message under the field and marks the input invalid with Bootstrap styles.
A Reset button clears the form with React Hook Form's reset().
note: A minimal 2023 practice project for form validation in React with TypeScript.
